subject: Error when using geom_map() with fortify: "Error in as.vector(x, mode) : cannot coerce type..."

messages.author: 746a110d20a6f112
messages.subject: Error when using geom_map() with fortify: "Error in as.vector(x, mode) : cannot coerce type..."
parts:
Hi-

I posted this 5 days ago under a different topic (just geom_map()) but the original problem was somewhat different, the subject not specific, and I did not get any responses, so I thought I would repost with a topic heading specific to my problem. Apologies for any confusion.

I am getting several inconsistent errors when I try to run geom_map(). I say 'inconsistent' because the errors I get in a minimal reproducible environment are different than when I run it in a larger code set I am using.

Here is the reproducible example:
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(sp)
library(maptools)
gpclibPermit()

load(url('http://dl.dropbox.com/u/9577903/geom_maperror.Rdata'))
#contains data.frame 'd' and spatial polygons data.frame 'ds'

pmap<-fortify(ds) #also tried fortify.sp()

p1<-ggplot(d,aes(map_id=
ip89DId))
p1<-pmap+geom_map(aes(fill=PopChg,map_id=id),map=pmap)
p1
#--Produces this Error:
#Error in as.vector(x, mode) : cannot coerce type 'environment' to vector of type 'any'

#---I also tried this----
names(d)[1]<-'id'
p1<-ggplot(d,aes(map_id=id))
p1<-pmap+geom_map(aes(fill=PopChg),map=pmap)
p1
#produces the same error

However, when I run the same code on the same data, in a larger script I am writing, I get the error that Aurelie Cosande mentioned:


Error in UseMethod("scale_dimension") :
  no applicable method for 'scale_dimension' applied to an object of class "NULL"


I can make it all work with geom_polygon() but wanted to try geom_map() just to keep pace with current changes. This begs the question, are there any inherent advantages to using geom_map() over geom_polygon()?

Thanks anyone for your help.

Fd

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: Error when using geom_map() with fortify: "Error in as.vector(x, mode) : cannot coerce type..."
parts: There were a couple things that needed to be tweaked... I've noted the changes below:

# Convert pmap$id from factor to integer, to match d$id
pmap$id <- as.integer(pmap$id)

names(d)[1]<-'id'
p1 <- ggplot(d, aes(fill=PopChg, map_id=id))
p1 <- p1 + geom_map(map=pmap1)     # Add to p1 here, not pmap

# Use expand_limits to set the x/y limits from the data
# Use coord_equal to force equal scaling
p1 + expand_limits(x = pmap1$lon, y = pmap1$lat) + coord_equal()


-Winston

messages.subject: Re: Error when using geom_map() with fortify: "Error in as.vector(x, mode) : cannot coerce type..."
parts:
Hi Winston-

Thanks for the reply. The error I was getting in my original code (not what I posted here) had to do with the expand_limits() argument.

I never had to use that before when using geom_polygon. Is that an intential feature of geom_map? It seems like it automatically expand the limits based on the data.

Finally, this all came about because I wanted to start using geom_map instead of geom_polygon for mapping shapefiles? Aside from the different syntax is there any inherent advantage to geom_map over geom_polygon?

Thanks again for all the great work.

F
